universe.title: Where the two crafts meet.
universe.sub: Engineering on one side, hospitality on the other — and the bridges that prove they're the same discipline. Drag a star, click a bridge, or switch the audience mode up top to light up one craft.
universe.hint: The gold nodes are the bridges — ideas both crafts share.

intro.title: Two crafts. One discipline.
intro.p1: For 14 years I ran bars — from Yerevan to the Metropol in Moscow to Dubai's busiest sports bar. Hospitality taught me the hardest skill there is: reading people, under pressure, every single night.
intro.p2: Then I taught myself to build software. Not toy projects — a real production platform with a multi-cloud storage engine, hardened auth, and four languages, deployed on AWS.
intro.p3: Code scales what hospitality taught me: care about the person on the other side. That's the whole philosophy — in a cocktail or in an API.

items.title: Twenty outlets at once
